topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I noticed it first in the quiet of the morning, the sleek car slipping into the garage next door, a model I recognized from the glossy pages of magazines. It's hard to breathe when the world shifts like this, when you start to see the finer details, the things you didn't know to look for. The perfect manicure, the subtle sparkle of a designer bag. I find myself glancing at my own hands, rough from years of work, and at the well-worn things around me. The evening silence feels heavier now, filled with questions I didn’t know to ask before.
